    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`This guide shows how to add a new tile to the dashboard application with optimized data loading for mobile devices. By using `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` with `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-qbe-filter`}</inlineCode>{`, you can reuse data already downloaded by other mobile applications while maintaining efficient memory usage through QBE filtering.`}</p>
    <blockquote>
      <p parentName="blockquote"><strong parentName="p">{`📋 Version Requirement`}</strong>{`: The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` mechanism was introduced in `}<strong parentName="p">{`Maximo Application Suite (MAS) version 9.2.0`}</strong>{`. Ensure your environment is running MAS 9.2.0 or later to use this feature.`}</p>
    </blockquote>
    <blockquote>
      <p parentName="blockquote"><strong parentName="p">{`📚 For comprehensive details on cross-app data sharing`}</strong>{`, see the `}<a parentName="p" {...{
          "href": "/configuration-practices-documentation/advanced/cross-app-datasource-sharing"
        }}>{`Cross-App Datasource Sharing Guide`}</a>{` which covers multiple fallback sources, schema requirements, and advanced patterns.`}</p>
    </blockquote>
    <h3>{`What is a Dashboard Tile?`}</h3>
    <p>{`Dashboard tiles are visual components that display key metrics and counts on the dashboard page. Each tile shows a title, a numeric value, and an optional unit label, with navigation to the related app.`}</p>

    <h2>{`Why Use mobile-shared-data-from with mobile-qbe-filter?`}</h2>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Benefits:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Memory Efficient`}</strong>{`: Prevents duplicate data downloads across apps`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Faster Loading`}</strong>{`: Reuses data already downloaded by other mobile apps`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Filtered Data`}</strong>{`: QBE ensures only relevant records are counted`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ `}<strong parentName="li">{`Reduced Network Usage`}</strong>{`: No additional server calls needed`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example Scenario:`}</strong>{`
The Inventory Receiving app already downloads purchase orders. Instead of downloading the same purchase orders again for the dashboard, we can reuse that data with `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` and filter it with `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-qbe-filter`}</inlineCode>{` to show only POs that haven’t been received.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Implementation`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Identify the source datasource from another mobile app`}</h3>
    <p>{`First, identify which mobile application already downloads the data you need for your tile. Common sources:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Technician App`}</strong>{` (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`techmobile`}</inlineCode>{`): Work orders`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Inspection App`}</strong>{` (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`inspection`}</inlineCode>{`): Inspection results`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Material Request App`}</strong>{` (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`materialrequest`}</inlineCode>{`): Material requests`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Service Request App`}</strong>{` (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`srmobile`}</inlineCode>{`): Service requests`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Inventory Receiving App`}</strong>{` (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`irmobile`}</inlineCode>{`): Purchase orders`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Inventory Transfer App`}</strong>{` (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`itmobile`}</inlineCode>{`): Reservations`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Inventory Counting App`}</strong>{` (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`icmobile`}</inlineCode>{`): Count books`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Create datasource with mobile-shared-data-from and mobile-qbe-filter`}</h3>
    <p>{`Define a datasource that references the source app’s datasource using `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` and applies `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-qbe-filter`}</inlineCode>{` for memory optimization.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`XML Configuration (app.xml):`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource 
  id="dspolist" 
  download-page-size="900" 
  page-size="1" 
  offline-immediate-download="true" 
  object-structure="MXAPIPO" 
  controller="DataController" 
  selection-mode="none" 
  saved-query="IROPENPOMOBILE" 
  order-by="ponum" 
  pre-load="true" 
  id-attribute="poid" 
  mobile-qbe-filter="{{'receipts_maxvalue': '=NONE'}}" 
  include-counts="true">
  
  <schema id="vm74dp">
    <attribute name="ponum" searchable="true" filterable="true" sortable="true" 
               title="PO Number" id="w7_2m"/>
    <attribute name="poid" unique-id="true" id="zmg9m" sortable="false"/>
    <attribute name="receipts" searchable="true" id="y5db9" sortable="false"/>
    <attribute name="computedTotalRecords" computed-function="computedTotalRecords" 
               title="PO not received" remarks="PO not received" id="dwg_k"/>
  </schema>
  
  <qbe id="pxk65">
    <qbe-field name="receipts" operator="=" value="NONE" id="ey_6z"/>
  </qbe>
  
  <!-- Share data from Inventory Receiving app -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="irmobile" datasource-id="executionPODS" id="link6"/>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Points:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`mobile-qbe-filter="{{'receipts_maxvalue': '=NONE'}}"`}</inlineCode>{`: Filters to show only POs not received`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{`: References the source app (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`irmobile`}</inlineCode>{`) and datasource (`}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`executionPODS`}</inlineCode>{`)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`page-size="1"`}</inlineCode>{`: Minimal page size since we only need the count`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`controller="DataController"`}</inlineCode>{`: Required for computed attributes like `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`computedTotalRecords`}</inlineCode></li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`include-counts="true"`}</inlineCode>{`: Enables count computation`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`<qbe>`}</inlineCode>{` element: Additional QBE filtering (optional, complements mobile-qbe-filter)`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Step 3: Add dashboard tile to page`}</h3>
    <p>{`Use the datasource in your dashboard tile. This will create a tile component that displays the count value.`}</p>

        "alt": "PO Tile Example",

        "src": "/configuration-practices-documentation/static/78a89ccee707953dc558743b51a362fb/4435e/dashboard-tile-po-received.png",
        "srcSet": ["/configuration-practices-documentation/static/78a89ccee707953dc558743b51a362fb/7fc1e/dashboard-tile-po-received.png 288w", "/configuration-practices-documentation/static/78a89ccee707953dc558743b51a362fb/a5df1/dashboard-tile-po-received.png 576w", "/configuration-practices-documentation/static/78a89ccee707953dc558743b51a362fb/4435e/dashboard-tile-po-received.png 648w"],

    `}</span>
    <p><em parentName="p">{`Example tile showing “POs to be received” with count of 6 Items`}</em></p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`XML Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"

  <dashboard id="dsdash1" use-with-mobile="true">
    
    <!-- POs to be received tile -->
    <dashboard-value-tile 
      id="dsdash1_t6" 
      datasource="dspolist" 
      size="smallwide"

      allow-extra-action="true" 
      on-extra-action-click="handleExtraAction"

      extra-actions="{{icon: 'carbon:chevron--right', title: 'Go to inventory receiving'}}" 
      hidden="{page.state.hideIRMobileTiles}"/>
      
  </dashboard>
</page>
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Complete Example`}</h2>
    <p>{`Here’s a complete example showing two tiles for purchase order status:`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`app.xml:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<maximo-application id="dashboardmobile" title="Dashboard" version="9.2.4.0">
  
  <!-- Tile 1: POs not received -->
  <maximo-datasource 
    id="dspolist" 
    download-page-size="900" 
    page-size="1" 
    offline-immediate-download="true" 
    object-structure="MXAPIPO" 
    controller="DataController" 
    selection-mode="none" 
    saved-query="IROPENPOMOBILE" 
    order-by="ponum" 
    pre-load="true" 
    id-attribute="poid" 
    mobile-qbe-filter="{{'receipts_maxvalue': '=NONE'}}" 
    include-counts="true">
    
    <schema id="vm74dp">
      <attribute name="ponum" searchable="true" filterable="true" sortable="true" 
                 title="PO Number" id="w7_2m"/>
      <attribute name="poid" unique-id="true" id="zmg9m" sortable="false"/>
      <attribute name="receipts" searchable="true" id="y5db9" sortable="false"/>
      <attribute name="computedTotalRecords" computed-function="computedTotalRecords" 
                 title="PO not received" remarks="PO not received" id="dwg_k"/>
    </schema>
    
    <qbe id="pxk65">
      <qbe-field name="receipts" operator="=" value="NONE" id="ey_6z"/>
    </qbe>
    
    <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="irmobile" datasource-id="executionPODS" id="link6"/>
  </maximo-datasource>
  
  <!-- Tile 2: POs partially received -->
  <maximo-datasource 
    id="dspolist1" 
    download-page-size="900" 
    page-size="1" 
    offline-immediate-download="true" 
    object-structure="MXAPIPO" 
    controller="DataController" 
    selection-mode="none" 
    saved-query="IROPENPOMOBILE" 
    order-by="ponum" 
    pre-load="true" 
    id-attribute="poid" 
    mobile-qbe-filter="{{'receipts_maxvalue': '=PARTIAL'}}" 
    include-counts="true">
    
    <schema id="x4dn_">
      <attribute name="ponum" searchable="true" filterable="true" sortable="true" 
                 title="PO Number" id="j64xq"/>
      <attribute name="poid" unique-id="true" sortable="false" id="ndgdp"/>
      <attribute name="receipts" searchable="true" sortable="false" id="q_b4y"/>
      <attribute name="computedTotalRecords" computed-function="computedTotalRecords" 
                 title="PO partial received" remarks="PO partial received" id="ea95p"/>
    </schema>
    
    <qbe id="zv6aa">
      <qbe-field name="receipts" operator="=" value="PARTIAL" id="kpa73"/>
    </qbe>
    
    <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="irmobile" datasource-id="executionPODS" id="link7"/>
  </maximo-datasource>
  
  <!-- Dashboard page -->
  <pages id="pages">
    <page id="dashboardpage" title="Dashboard" controller="DashboardController">
      <dashboard id="dsdash1" use-with-mobile="true">
        
        <!-- POs to be received -->
        <dashboard-value-tile 
          id="dsdash1_t6" 
          datasource="dspolist" 
          size="smallwide" 
          value-field="computedTotalRecords" 
          title="POs to be received" 
          unit="request" 
          allow-extra-action="true" 
          on-extra-action-click="handleExtraAction" 
          on-extra-action-click-arg="{{name: 'irmobile'}}" 
          extra-actions="{{icon: 'carbon:chevron--right', title: 'Go to inventory receiving'}}" 
          hidden="{page.state.hideIRMobileTiles}"/>
        
        <!-- POs partially received -->
        <dashboard-value-tile 
          id="dsdash1_t7" 
          datasource="dspolist1" 
          size="smallwide" 
          value-field="computedTotalRecords" 
          title="POs partially received" 
          unit="request" 
          allow-extra-action="true" 
          on-extra-action-click="handleExtraAction" 
          on-extra-action-click-arg="{{name: 'irmobile'}}" 
          extra-actions="{{icon: 'carbon:chevron--right', title: 'Go to inventory receiving'}}" 
          hidden="{page.state.hideIRMobileTiles}"/>
          
      </dashboard>
    </page>
  </pages>
</maximo-application>
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`mobile-qbe-filter Examples for Memory Management`}</h2>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-qbe-filter`}</inlineCode>{` attribute filters the shared data to reduce memory usage. Here are common patterns:`}</p>
    <h3>{`Example 1: Filter by Exact Value`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`mobile-qbe-filter="{{'receipts_maxvalue': '=NONE'}}"
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 2: Filter by Status (Exclude Multiple)`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status_maxvalue': '!=COMP,CAN,CLOSE,WAPPR'}}"
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 3: Filter by Priority Range`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`mobile-qbe-filter="{{'wopriority': '<=2'}}"
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 4: Multiple Filters Combined`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status_maxvalue': '!=COMP,CAN,CLOSE', 'wopriority': '<=3'}}"
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 5: Filter with Specific Status Values`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status_maxvalue': '!=COMPLETED, CAN, REVIEW', 'historyflag': '!=true'}}"
`}</code></pre>

      </tbody>
    </table>
    <h2>{`Validation & Testing`}</h2>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`How to verify:`}</strong></p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Check data sharing is working:`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Install both source app (e.g., Inventory Receiving) and dashboard app`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Open source app first and let it download data`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Open dashboard app`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Verify tile displays count without additional network calls`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Check browser DevTools Network tab`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Test mobile-qbe-filter:`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Verify tile shows only filtered records`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Check count matches filter criteria`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Compare with source app’s filtered count`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Test offline mode:`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Load source app while online`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Enable airplane mode`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Open dashboard app`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Verify tile displays data from shared source`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Monitor memory usage:`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Open DevTools Memory tab`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Verify no duplicate data in memory`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Check page-size limits are respected (page-size=“1” for count-only tiles)`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Common Issues:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Issue:`}</strong>{` Tile shows 0 or no data`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Cause:`}</strong>{` Source app not installed or data not downloaded`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Solution:`}</strong>{` Ensure source app is installed and has downloaded data first`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ul">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Issue:`}</strong>{` “Object structure mismatch” error`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Cause:`}</strong>{` Datasource uses different object-structure than source`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Solution:`}</strong>{` Verify object-structure matches exactly (case-sensitive)`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ul">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Issue:`}</strong>{` Wrong app-id or datasource-id`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Cause:`}</strong>{` Incorrect reference to source datasource`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Solution:`}</strong>{` Check source app’s app.xml for correct IDs`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ul">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Issue:`}</strong>{` mobile-qbe-filter not working`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Cause:`}</strong>{` Incorrect filter syntax or field names`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Solution:`}</strong>{` Verify field names exist in object structure schema`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ul">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Issue:`}</strong>{` computedTotalRecords not showing`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Cause:`}</strong>{` Missing controller=“DataController” or include-counts=“true”`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Solution:`}</strong>{` Add both attributes to datasource`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`Best Practices`}</h2>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`✅ Do:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` to reuse data from other mobile apps`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Apply `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`mobile-qbe-filter`}</inlineCode>{` to limit records for memory management`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Set `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`page-size="1"`}</inlineCode>{` for count-only tiles (no need to load all records)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`controller="DataController"`}</inlineCode>{` for computed attributes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Set `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`include-counts="true"`}</inlineCode>{` to enable count computation`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Add `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`computedTotalRecords`}</inlineCode>{` attribute to schema for tile display`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Test with source app installed and data downloaded`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Document which source apps are required`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`❌ Don’t:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Reference non-existent app-id or datasource-id`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use different object-structure than source datasource`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Forget to install source app during testing`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Skip mobile-qbe-filter (loads all shared data unnecessarily)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Forget to add computed attributes to schema when required`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Set large page-size for count-only tiles`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Memory Optimization Tips:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Always use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`mobile-qbe-filter`}</inlineCode>{` to limit records`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Filter out completed/closed records when not needed`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`page-size="1"`}</inlineCode>{` for tiles that only display counts`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Set appropriate `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`download-page-size`}</inlineCode>{` based on expected data volume`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Test on actual mobile devices to verify memory usage`}</li>
    </ul>

    <h2>{`Summary`}</h2>
    <p>{`This simple configuration approach is ideal when:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Another mobile app already downloads the data you need`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ You can filter data with mobile-qbe-filter (no complex logic needed)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ You only need to display counts (use page-size=“1”)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Memory optimization is a priority`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ You want to avoid duplicate data downloads`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p>{`For scenarios requiring all records or complex data processing with DataController, see the `}<a parentName="p" {...{
